entities.name: Edith
entities.description: A fervent cultist of Emrakul who merged with the titan at its emergence on Innistrad.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan whose emergence on Innistrad Edith witnessed; she acknowledged Edith's devotion.

events.summary: Emrakul acknowledged Edith's devotion, rose from a column of water, and Edith merged with her.
events.quote: Edith merged with Emrakul, feeling complete and transformed by her power.

relations.quote: Edith is a fervent devotee and cultist of Emrakul
